Name: Euodias
Summary: Euodias (Euodia) was a Philippian believer whom Paul beseeches, along with Syntyche, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
KeyStory: Euodias (Euodia) was a Philippian believer whom Paul beseeches, along with Syntyche, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
LifeLesson: Unity in the Lord is not uniformity of opinion but agreement in Christ.
